first_prompt_cancelled.caution: The program restores the 2000 factory defaults (*RST) before the first point, then sets function, range, speed and filter for every point.
steps: Warm-up
The 2000 must have been on for at least one hour (Cal Manual p. 1-3). Allow the calibrator its own warm-up time as well.
Environment
Ambient 18 to 28 C and relative humidity below 80 % (p. 1-3).
Inputs
Set the INPUTS switch to FRONT. The program reads the switch and stops if it is on REAR.
Direct connections
Connect the calibrator straight to the 2000: no scanner or other switching equipment (p. 1-6).

high_voltage_refused.text:
Before the first test point every instrument is reset to its default settings.

Unit under test that will be reset: 2000.

Resetting a unit under test can ERASE settings stored on it (set-ups, configuration, preferences). Save anything you need from it first.

Reset the instruments and start?
high_voltage_refused.title: Reset instruments

high_voltage_refused.caution: Continue only after physically verifying the connections.
steps: Standby
The calibrator is put in STANDBY before you rewire.
Wiring
Shielded cable, shield to the calibrator LO. Calibrator OUTPUT V/ohm HI / LO to the 2000 INPUT HI / LO (Figure 1-1); low-thermal connections for the 100 mV and 1 V ranges.
REL zero
With the calibrator at 0.00000 mV DC the program enables REL on the 100 mV range and leaves it on for the DC volts points (p. 1-7).

steps: Standby
The calibrator is put in STANDBY before you rewire.
Wiring
Shielded cable, shield to the calibrator LO. Calibrator OUTPUT V/ohm HI / LO to the 2000 INPUT HI / LO (Figure 1-2).
Speed
AC uses detector bandwidth 3 (slow) with the digital filter off: one reading takes about 2 s and the program waits 20 s (default, tunable) after the output is on for the detector to settle.

steps: Standby
The calibrator is put in STANDBY before you rewire.
Wiring
Calibrator VI AUX output and OUTPUT LO to the 2000 AMPS and INPUT LO jacks (Figure 1-3). Check the calibrator range, its fuse and the 2000 AMPS fuse (3 A, 250 V) first.
virtual_run.title: Rewire / verify before enabling output

virtual_run.caution: Continue only after physically verifying the connections.
facts: AC current 1.000 A @ 1.000 kHz, 1.000 A range
steps: Standby
The calibrator is put in STANDBY before you rewire.
Wiring
Calibrator VI AUX output and OUTPUT LO to the 2000 AMPS and INPUT LO jacks (Figure 1-4). Check the calibrator range, its fuse and the 2000 AMPS fuse (3 A, 250 V) first.
Speed
AC uses detector bandwidth 3 (slow) with the digital filter off: one reading takes about 2 s and the program waits 20 s (default, tunable) after the output is on for the detector to settle.
virtual_run.title: Rewire / verify before enabling output

virtual_run.caution: Continue only after physically verifying the connections.
steps: Standby
The calibrator is put in STANDBY before you rewire.
Wiring

4-wire: calibrator OUTPUT V/ohm HI / LO (force) to the 2000 INPUT HI / LO and the calibrator SENSE HI / LO to the 2000 SENSE Ohms 4 WIRE HI / LO (Figure 1-5); calibrator external sense ON. Set the 5560A's own 4-wire (external sense) mode for the points below 110 kohm; the program sends no compensation command to a 5560A.
virtual_run.title: Rewire / verify before enabling output

virtual_run.caution: Continue only after physically verifying the connections.
steps: Standby
The calibrator is put in STANDBY before you rewire.
Wiring

Pure 2-wire hook-up: calibrator OUTPUT V/ohm HI / LO to the 2000 INPUT HI / LO only. NO sense leads: nothing on the 2000 SENSE Ohms 4 WIRE jacks and the calibrator external sense OFF; shielded cable. The program selects the 2000 2-wire resistance function (not 4-wire). Set the 5560A to its 2-wire mode (external sense off); the program sends no compensation command to a 5560A.
virtual_run.title: Rewire / verify before enabling output
